verdicts.why: Shifting cultivation is abandoned because soil fertility falls once burning's nutrients are used up. The other options describe events unrelated to abandonment. Key A is unique.

Commercial ranching on fenced pastures is classic in the Pampas of Argentina and in Australia. The distractors are dairy (Netherlands, Denmark) and rice (Bangladesh, Myanmar, Japan, South Korea) regions.
Plantation to III, shifting cultivation to II, Mediterranean to IV and commercial grain farming to I. Each of the other three options mismatches at least two pairs.

Statements A, B and D are true (nomads have no permanent settlement, transhumance is seasonal highland-lowland movement, nomadism suits arid lands). C is false because commercial ranching is not nomadic. Key D is unique.
TISCO at Jamshedpur (1907) is the first integrated iron and steel plant in India. Bhilai, Rourkela and Durgapur are later public-sector plants.

Key A (cotton textiles and sugar) is correct and unique. The explanation sentence grouped fertilisers with iron ore, which read as an error; the sentence was rewritten so each industry's raw material is stated correctly.

verdicts.why: Ginning, spinning, weaving, then bleaching, dyeing and finishing is the correct order. Key D (B, C, A, D) is unique and each distractor misplaces the first or third stage.
Retail trade is a tertiary service. Biotechnology research, software development and data analysis are knowledge-based quaternary activities. Key B is unique.
The Suez Canal links the Mediterranean and the Red Sea. The Panama Canal joins the Atlantic and Pacific, and the other pairs are not canal links that shorten Europe-South Asia routes.
The Golden Quadrilateral links Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata. Hyderabad is not on it and is the only NOT-linked option. Key A is unique.
Latitudes run Kandla (about 23N), Mumbai (about 19N), Mangaluru (about 13N), Kochi (about 10N). Key A (B, D, A, C) is the only option in that order.

Submarine cables lie on the ocean floor (II), satellite relays from geostationary orbit (III), optical fibre carries light pulses (I), and the telegraph uses dots and dashes (IV). Key D is the only full match.
Balance of trade is visible exports minus visible imports. The other options describe total trade, the balance of payments or capital flows.

A (BoP covers all transactions with the rest of the world) and C (remittances are current-account transfers) are true. B is false because BoT is goods only, and D is false because BoT and BoP differ. Key C is unique.
A conurbation is a merged urban area formed by neighbouring towns and cities. Hamlet, dispersed and linear settlements are rural forms.
A megalopolis is a chain of merged metropolitan regions, and the Boston to Washington corridor is the classic example. The conurbation option is a single merged area, not a chain.
